text: For each root $\alpha$, the elements $e_\alpha \in \mathfrak{g}_\alpha$, $f_\alpha \in \mathfrak{g}_{-\alpha}$, and $h_\alpha = [e_\alpha, f_\alpha] \in \mathfrak{h}$ span a subalgebra isomorphic to ___.
explanation: Each root determines an $\mathfrak{sl}_2$-triple, and the three elements span a copy of $\mathfrak{sl}_2$ inside $\mathfrak{g}$. This embedding lets $\mathfrak{sl}_2$ representation theory control the root strings and forces the Cartan integers to be integers.
